Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: FIX.4.0 or FIX.4.1 or FIX.4.2. Must be the first field in message.

Field.Name: BodyLength
Field.Description: Must be second field in the message.

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: Must be the third field in the message.

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum
Field.Description: Message sequence number.

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: SenderCompID as assigned by NASDAQ. It will always be four to six characters. The SenderCompID returned within all messages is NSDQ.

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: NSDQ

Field.Name: SenderSubID
Field.Description: It must be 32 characters or less. RFP Notification messages do not include any firm identifiers in Tag 50.

Field.Name: TargetSubID
Field.Description: Ignored

Field.Name: PossDupFlag
Field.Description: Always required for retransmitted messages, whether prompted by the sending system or as the result of a resend request.

Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: Required when message may be duplicate of another message sent under a different sequence number.

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime
Field.Description: Required for message resends. If data is not available set to same value as SendingTime.

Field.Name: CheckSum
Field.Description: Three-digit character. Must be last field in the message

Message.Name: Heartbeat
Message.Description: Standard FIX 4.2 session message. Sent when the agreed HeartbeatInterval has elapsed since the last message sent, and in reply to a Test Request.

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Required when the heartbeat is the result of a Test Request message. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Identifier included in the Test Request message to be returned in the resulting Heartbeat. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Message.Name: ResendRequest
Message.Description: Standard FIX 4.2 session message. Open (EndSeqNo 0) and closed sequence ranges are honored.

Field.Name: BeginSeqNo
Field.Description: Message sequence number of first message in range to be resent. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Field.Name: EndSeqNo
Field.Description: Message sequence number of last message in range to be resent; 0 for infinity. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Field.Name: RefSeqNum
Field.Description: MsgSeqNum of rejected message. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Field.Name: RefTagID
Field.Description: The tag number of the FIX field being referenced. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Field.Name: RefMsgType
Field.Description: The MsgType of the FIX message being referenced. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Field.Name: SessionRejectReason
Field.Description: Code to identify reason for a session-level Reject message. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Where possible, message to explain reason for rejection. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Message.Name: SequenceReset
Message.Description: Standard FIX 4.2 session message. Gap Fill (GapFillFlag = Y) messages follow standard sequencing; Reset (GapFillFlag not Y) is used only as a last resort, by human intervention.

Field.Name: GapFillFlag
Field.Description: Indicates that the Sequence Reset message is replacing administrative or application messages which will not be resent. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Field.Name: NewSeqNo
Field.Description: New sequence number. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Message.Name: Logout
Message.Description: Standard FIX 4.2 session message. Either side may issue a Logout to gracefully close the session.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Free format text. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Message.Name: Logon
Message.Description: The first message should be a logon message. No additional messages should be transmitted until NASDAQ has verified the SenderCompID and a logon is received from NASDAQ. NASDAQ does not support encryption.

Field.Name: EncryptMethod
Field.Description: Not listed in the document Logon table; FIX 4.2 standard required field. NASDAQ does not support encryption: 0 = None.

Field.Name: HeartBtInt
Field.Description: Heartbeat interval in seconds.

Message.Name: NewOrderSingle
Message.Description: Submits a new options order with special handling and execution instructions; also initiates (AuctionType P with RFPInstr) and responds to (AuctionType P with RFPID) a Request for PRISM, and responds to PRISM and Block auctions. New Order messages received with a duplicate ClOrdID will be ignored, regardless of PossResend. Attributable orders are not supported. In case of absence of TimeInForce the order is treated as a DAY order.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the order as assigned by institution. Must be 20 characters or less.

Field.Name: HandlInst
Field.Description: If provided, must be set to 1 = Automated execution order, private, no Broker intervention

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: 1 - 6 character Options Root Symbol. Spaces, periods, commas not allowed.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of order: 1 = Buy, 2 = Sell

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Required. Acceptable range is 1 to 999999. No commas, decimals or spaces allowed, nor are negative numbers.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: 1 = Market, 2 = Limit

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price field is required for Limit Orders. 1-10 character decimal price. 12.34 is the correct presentation of twelve dollars and thirty-four cents

Field.Name: ClientID
Field.Description: Used for firm identification. Service bureaus must use this field to specify the firm entering the order. The firm identifier must be a valid mnemonic assigned by the exchange and the firm must be an approved member of the exchange. If this field is not provided by the firm, the default mnemonic associated with the FIX port will be used.

Field.Name: ExecBroker
Field.Description: Routing Strategy or special handling instruction for the order: FIND, SRCH, DNR or POST. If not specified, or specified with an instruction not listed, will default to the firm's default execBroker as setup with NASDAQ. IOC orders will be converted to DNR orders.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Must be 32 characters or less.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: Can contain only one instruction. f = InterMarket Sweep Order (ISO), G = All Or None (AON); AON orders with a TIF other than IOC will be treated as IOC.

Field.Name: MinQty
Field.Description: MinQty is currently supported, but NASDAQ does not allow orders with a MinQty to remain live on the book: specify IOC in the TIF field (tag 59=3); any other TIF is automatically converted to IOC.

Field.Name: MaxFloor
Field.Description: Not Supported.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: Specifies how long the order remains in effect: 0 = Market Hours (DAY), 1 = Good Till Cancel (GTC), 2 = OPG (Open Cross), 3 = Immediate or Cancel (IOC), 4 = Fill Or Kill (equivalent to MinQty = OrderQty), 6 = Good Till Time (no longer supported, converted to IOC on arrival). Absence of this field is interpreted as Immediate or Cancel in the table, and as a DAY order in the note following it.

Field.Name: Rule80A
Field.Description: Named Rule80A/OrderCapacity in the document. C = customer order, B = BrokerDealer Order, F = firm order, M = Nasdaq registered market maker order, O = Other Exchange registered market maker order, P = Professional Customer, J = Joint Back Office. If not specified, will default to C (Customer order).

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Firms can use this field in order message to supply optional clearing data field that is sent to OCC. If field is supplied, NASDAQ will allow only 13 characters and use it for supplementary ID in the order.

Field.Name: ExpireTime
Field.Description: Not Supported.

Field.Name: OpenClose
Field.Description: O = opening position, C = closing position

Field.Name: SecurityType
Field.Description: If provided, must be OPT = options

Field.Name: MaturityMonthYear
Field.Description: Format: YYYYMM (expiration date). If this tag and Maturity Date (tag 541) is specified the year and month must match, otherwise the order will be rejected. Required unless Maturity Date is specified.

Field.Name: MaturityDay
Field.Description: Format: DD (Expiration date-day of the month). If supplied, this data will be validated. If this tag and Maturity Date (tag 541) is specified the day must match, otherwise the order will be rejected. Required unless Maturity Date is specified.

Field.Name: MaturityDate
Field.Description: Month, Day and Year of the maturity. Format YYYYMMDD (e.g. 20100918 to represent Sept 18, 2010). If this tag and MaturityMonthYear and MaturityDay is specified the year, month and day must match, otherwise the order will be rejected. Required unless MaturityMonthYear AND MaturityDay is specified.

Field.Name: PutOrCall
Field.Description: 0 = put, 1 = call

Field.Name: StrikePrice
Field.Description: Strike Price for option. Valid values: 0 - 999999.99999999

Field.Name: ClearingAccount
Field.Description: Up to 5-character alphanumeric. If tag is not supplied, spaces will be used. This field is passed through to the OCC sub-account/multi-account field; at the OCC this field is used to clear the trade to the proper sub account. The value is sometimes referred to as Badge # or Market Maker ID and is usually a 1-4-character alphanumeric acronym. Nasdaq will forward only left most 4 characters to OCC. Required if Order Capacity (tag 47) is M or O.

Field.Name: SecurityExchange
Field.Description: Exchange ID of Market Maker. When Rule80A/Capacity is O, this field should indicate Exchange where Market Maker is registered. If not provided, will default to T for BX Options.

Field.Name: ClearingFirm
Field.Description: CMTA Number (firm that will clear the trade) up to 5-character numeric. If tag not supplied, this order will not be a CMTA.

Field.Name: AllocAccount
Field.Description: Exchange Internal Firm Identifier of the Directed Participant for Directed Order Flow; should not exceed 4 characters.

Field.Name: AuctionType
Field.Description: Conditional: must be specified if the order is a response to an auction or a Request for PRISM. P = PRISM Cross, B = Block Auction. If an auction of the indicated type is active for the specified symbol the order may participate in it and any unexecuted quantity is cancelled at the end of the auction; otherwise the order is immediately cancelled. AuctionType P initiates a Request for PRISM together with RFPInstr (9211).

Field.Name: AuctionID
Field.Description: Conditional. Numeric auction id that this order is joining. When AuctionType is provided, AuctionID must be provided in order to respond to an auction. If RFPID and AuctionID are provided, the response will be rejected. If this field is specified but AuctionType is not, the order will be rejected.

Field.Name: ExposureFlag
Field.Description: H = Hide All, I = Instruction (Buy/Sell), P = Premium (Limit Price), Q = Quantity. Attributable orders are not supported: values related to attributable orders will be cancelled.

Field.Name: NWTOrdType
Field.Description: Conditional. Named NWT Order Type in the document. 1 = MKT, 2 = LIMIT. Used for RFP by the Responder.

Field.Name: NWTPrice
Field.Description: Conditional. Named NWT Price in the document. Required if NWT OrderType is LIMIT. Must match or improve Price (44). Used for RFP by the Responder.

Field.Name: BrokerPCT
Field.Description: Conditional. 0 <= n <= 40 (default value = 40). Used for RFP by the Responder.

Field.Name: RFPID
Field.Description: Conditional. Unique identifier assigned by the exchange, as provided on the Request for PRISM Notification. Used for RFP by the Responder.

Field.Name: RFPInstr
Field.Description: Conditional: required for initiating an RFP. B = Interact with Book upon unsuccessful RFP attempt, C = Cancel back upon unsuccessful RFP attempt.

Message.Name: NewOrderList
Message.Description: PRISM Cross: a list of exactly 2 orders, each a complete order definition with its own ClOrdID, representing the agency and initiating sides of the cross. Both sides specify the same order quantity, must be LIMIT and lock or cross; the initiating order may specify a No Worse Than (NWT) price. PRISM orders are converted to IOC; ExecBroker is ignored and neither side can be routable. Firms can never cancel a PRISM order; a replace may only improve the NWT price in favor of the agency order.

Field.Name: AuctionType
Field.Description: Auction type for this order: P = PRISM Cross, Y = Customer to Customer Cross

Field.Name: NWTOrdType
Field.Description: Conditional: PRISM Cross - Required. Named NWT OrdType in the document. The NWT OrdType is part of the NWT Price specification: 1 = MKT, 2 = LIMIT. Always assigned to the initiating order.

Field.Name: NWTPrice
Field.Description: Conditional: PRISM Cross - Required if the NWT OrdType = 2 (Limit). The NWT Price/NWT OrdType specification must match or improve the Price/OrdType fields of the initiating order. Decimal representation (up to 4 decimal digits) of NWT limit price. If NWT Order Type is NOT 2 (Limit), then this field must not be present.

Field.Name: BrokerPCT
Field.Description: Named BrokerPct in the document. 0 <= n <= 40 (default value = 40). PRISM orders only. Cannot be modified via a cross replace request.

Message.Name: OrderCancelRequest
Message.Description: Requests the cancellation of all of the remaining quantity of an existing order; accepted only if the order can successfully be pulled back from the exchange trading system without executing. The ClOrdID assigned to the cancel request must be unique amongst the ClOrdID assigned to regular orders and replacement orders.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID of the original order to cancel, as assigned by the originating participant (Firm).

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique ID of cancel request as assigned by the institution. Must be 20 characters or less.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: 1 - 6 character Options Root Symbol. Spaces, periods, commas not allowed.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of order: 1 = Buy, 2 = Sell

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: NASDAQ does not support CashOrderQty. Therefore, OrderQty is required.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of most recent order as assigned by broker.

Field.Name: ClientID
Field.Description: Used for firm identification. Service bureaus must use this field to specify the firm entering the order. The firm identifier must be a valid mnemonic assigned by the exchange and the firm must be an approved member of the exchange. If this field is not provided by the firm, the default mnemonic associated with the FIX port will be used.

Field.Name: MaturityMonthYear
Field.Description: Format: YYYYMM (expiration date). If this tag and Maturity Date (tag 541) is specified the year and month must match, otherwise the order cancel will be rejected. Required unless Maturity Date is specified.

Field.Name: MaturityDay
Field.Description: Format: DD (Expiration date-day of the month). If supplied, this data will be validated. If this tag and Maturity Date (tag 541) is specified the day must match, otherwise the order cancel will be rejected. Required unless Maturity Date is specified.

Field.Name: MaturityDate
Field.Description: Month, Day and Year of the maturity. Format YYYYMMDD (e.g. 20100918 to represent Sept 18, 2010). If this tag and MaturityMonthYear and MaturityDay is specified the year, month and day must match, otherwise the order cancel will be rejected. Required unless MaturityMonthYear AND MaturityDay is specified.

Field.Name: PutOrCall
Field.Description: 0 = put, 1 = call

Field.Name: StrikePrice
Field.Description: Strike Price for option. Valid values: 0 - 99999999.9999

Message.Name: OrderCancelReplaceRequest
Message.Description: Order Modification Request: changes the price, quantity, tif, order type, Account ID and AllocAccount of an existing order; all other fields should be retransmitted as sent in the original order. A change in price or an increase in quantity loses time priority. For PRISM Cross orders only the order type, order price, NWT Order Type and NWT price of the initiating order can be changed.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID of the original order to cancel, as assigned by the originating participant (Firm).

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of replacement order as assigned by institution. Used in the ClOrdID field of the Cancel Reject Message if the replacement request is rejected. Must be 20 characters or less.

Field.Name: HandlInst
Field.Description: If provided, must be set to 1 = Automated execution order, private, no Broker intervention

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: 1 - 6 character Options Root Symbol. Spaces, periods, commas not allowed.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of order: 1 = Buy, 2 = Sell. Must match original side.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: NASDAQ does not support CashOrderQty. Therefore, OrderQty is required.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: 1 = Market, 2 = Limit

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price field is required for Limit Orders.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of most recent order as assigned by broker.

Field.Name: ClientID
Field.Description: Used for firm identification. Service bureaus must use this field to specify the firm entering the order. The firm identifier must be a valid mnemonic assigned by the exchange and the firm must be an approved member of the exchange. If this field is not provided by the firm, the default mnemonic associated with the FIX port will be used.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: Not Supported. ExecInst of Original Order is carried through.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: If not provided, the time in force of the original order carries through to all replacements. Allowed changes: DAY to GTC or IOC, GTC to DAY or IOC; IOC to DAY or GTC is not a valid cancel replace action.

Field.Name: Rule80A
Field.Description: Named Rule80A/OrderCapacity in the document. The Rule80A (capacity) of the original order carries through to all replacements.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: If provided, it will be used after replace. If not provided, the account id of the original order will carry through.

Field.Name: MinQty
Field.Description: Not supported. The MinQty of the original order carries through to all replacements.

Field.Name: MaxFloor
Field.Description: Not supported.

Field.Name: SecurityType
Field.Description: If provided must be OPT = options

Field.Name: MaturityMonthYear
Field.Description: Format: YYYYMM (expiration date). If this tag and Maturity Date (tag 541) is specified the year and month must match, otherwise the order replace will be rejected. Required unless Maturity Date is specified.

Field.Name: MaturityDay
Field.Description: Format: DD (Expiration date-day of the month). If supplied, this data will be validated. If this tag and Maturity Date (tag 541) is specified the day must match, otherwise the order replace will be rejected. Required unless Maturity Date is specified.

Field.Name: MaturityDate
Field.Description: Month, Day and Year of the maturity. Format YYYYMMDD (e.g. 20100918 to represent Sept 18, 2010). If this tag and MaturityMonthYear and MaturityDay is specified the year, month and day must match, otherwise the order replace will be rejected. Required unless MaturityMonthYear AND MaturityDay is specified.

Field.Name: PutOrCall
Field.Description: 0 = put, 1 = call

Field.Name: StrikePrice
Field.Description: Strike Price for option. Valid values: 0 - 999999.99999999

Field.Name: AllocAccount
Field.Description: Exchange Internal Firm Identifier of the Directed Participant for Directed Order Flow; should not exceed 4 characters.

Field.Name: NWTOrdType
Field.Description: Conditional. Named NWT OrdType in the document. The No Worse Than (NWT) price type for a PRISM Cross initiating order; with NWT Price it must match or improve the last accepted values and the OrdType and Price of this replace message. 1 = MKT, 2 = LIMIT

Field.Name: NWTPrice
Field.Description: Conditional. Named NWT Price in the document. Required on the initiating order of a PRISM cross if the cancel replace NWT OrdType = 2 (Limit). Decimal representation (up to 4 decimal digits) of limit price; must match or improve the last accepted values. Can only be specified for the initiating order of a PRISM Cross; must not be present if NWT Order Type is not 2 (Limit) or not specified.

Message.Name: OrderMassCancelRequest
Message.Description: Purge/Reset Request from Firm: a purge request from a firm configured for risk protection, or the Reset request required after a RapidFire Notification. The document notes that the Purge/Reset message is not supported at the moment.

Field.Name: ClientID
Field.Description: If provided, must be a valid NASDAQ MPID/Firm Mnemonic. If not provided, the port's default MPID/Firm Mnemonic will be used

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Named CLOrdID in the document. Unique ID of Purge/Reset Request as assigned by the firm. Must be unique for the trading session.

Field.Name: UnderlyingSymbol
Field.Description: UnderlyingSymbol to purge or reset

Field.Name: RequestType
Field.Description: Purge/Reset Type: 8 = Reset, 2 = Purge

Message.Name: ExecutionReport
Message.Description: Confirms the receipt of an order or response, confirms changes to an existing order (accepted cancel and replace requests), relays order status information and fill information on working orders or responses, and rejects orders. Each execution message describes the current state of the order and execution status as understood by NASDAQ. BrokerPct (9204) is not provided in Execution Reports.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: OrderID, as assigned by NASDAQ, is required to be unique for each chain of orders.

Field.Name: ExecID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of execution message, such as a Trade ID, as assigned by PHLX-XL. Uniqueness is guaranteed within a single trading day for a given Firm Mnemonic. Receiving Firms should treat it as a free-form string. Assigned IDs should not exceed 36 characters.

Field.Name: ExecTransType
Field.Description: Identifies transaction type: 0 = New, 1 = Cancel, 3 = Status (OrdStatus = 3 (Done For Day))

Field.Name: ExecType
Field.Description: Describes the type of execution report: 0 = New, 1 = Partial Fill, 2 = Filled, 3 = Done for day, 4 = Cancelled, 5 = Replaced, 6 = Pending Cancel, 8 = Rejected, I = Order Status, E = Pending Replace. An RFP order converted to a regular order and rested is acknowledged with ExecType I, OrdStatus 0 and WorkingIndicator Y.

Field.Name: WorkingIndicator
Field.Description: Y = Order is currently being worked

Field.Name: OrdStatus
Field.Description: Describes the current state of a CHAIN of orders, same scope as OrderQty, CumQty, LeavesQty, and AvgPx: 0 = New, 1 = Partial Fill, 2 = Filled, 3 = Done for day, 4 = Cancelled, 5 = Replaced, 6 = Pending Cancel, 8 = Rejected

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: 1 - 6 character Options Root Symbol. Spaces, periods, commas not allowed.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of the order

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: The number of contracts.

Field.Name: LastShares
Field.Description: Number of contracts bought/sold on this (last) fill. Should be 0 for non-fills (fill defined as ExecTransType = New and ExecType = Partial Fill or Fill).

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Price of this (last) fill. Should be 0 for non-fills (fill defined as ExecTransType = New and ExecType = Partial Fill or Fill).

Field.Name: LastMkt
Field.Description: For option linkage trades, away execution exchange.

Field.Name: LeavesQty
Field.Description: Amount of contracts open for further execution. If the OrdStatus is Canceled, DoneForTheDay, Expired, Calculated, or Rejected (in which case the order is no longer active) then LeavesQty could be 0, otherwise LeavesQty = OrderQty - CumQty.

Field.Name: CumQty
Field.Description: Currently executed contracts for chain of orders.

Field.Name: AvgPx
Field.Description: Will be set to 0 always.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: As specified in the NewOrder

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: As specified in the NewOrder

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: As specified in the NewOrder

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: Required if this is in response to an Order Cancel Request or Order Cancel/Replace request (ExecType = PendingCancel, Replaced or Cancelled). ClOrdID of the previous order (NOT the initial order of the day) when cancelling or replacing an order and for unsolicited cancel reports.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: f = InterMarket Sweep Order (ISO), G = All Or None (AON)

Field.Name: TradeDate
Field.Description: Used when reporting other than current day trades.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: Absence of this field indicates Immediate or Cancel order

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: 1 = Market, 2 = Limit

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time of execution/order creation (expressed in UTC).

Field.Name: Rule80A
Field.Description: Named Rule80A/OrderCapacity in the document. Capacity (C, B, F, M, O, P or J) from original order.

Field.Name: OrdRejReason
Field.Description: Not listed in the document Execution Report table; section 7.1 (Rejected Order Reasons) pairs each reject Text with an OrdRejectReason code.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Free format text string. Returned within all order reject and cancel messages with a description of the reject or cancel (section 7).

Field.Name: LiquidityIndicator
Field.Description: Will be returned within all execution reports that contain a partial or full fill. See Liquidity Codes (section 7.3). NON-STANDARD field (BX).

Field.Name: OpenClose
Field.Description: O = opening position, C = closing position

Field.Name: SecurityType
Field.Description: OPT = options

Field.Name: MaturityMonthYear
Field.Description: Format: YYYYMM (expiration date). This will not be present If ExecType = 8 - Rejected

Field.Name: MaturityDay
Field.Description: Format: DD (Expiration date-day of the month). This will not be present If ExecType = 8 - Rejected

Field.Name: MaturityDate
Field.Description: Field name missing in the document table. Month, Day and Year of the maturity. Format YYYYMMDD (e.g. 20100918 to represent Sept 18, 2010). This will not be present If ExecType = 8 - Rejected

Field.Name: PutOrCall
Field.Description: 0 = put, 1 = call

Field.Name: StrikePrice
Field.Description: Strike Price for option. Valid values: 0 - 999999.99999999

Field.Name: AuctionType
Field.Description: Auction type for this order: P = PRISM Cross, B = Block Auction, Y = Customer to Customer Cross

Field.Name: NWTOrdType
Field.Description: Named NWT OrdType in the document. Present in all responses from the exchange for a PRISM Cross. The NWT OrdType is part of the NWT Price specification: 1 = MKT, 2 = LIMIT

Field.Name: NWTPrice
Field.Description: Named NWT Price in the document. Present in all responses from the exchange for a PRISM Cross with NWT OrderType = 2 (Limit).

Field.Name: ClearingAccount
Field.Description: Present if client provided it in the original order or order list message.

Field.Name: RFPID
Field.Description: Conditional: present on executions and acknowledgements related to RFPs

Message.Name: OrderCancelReject
Message.Description: Issued by NASDAQ upon receipt of a Cancel Request or Cancel/Replace Request Message that cannot be honored.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: If the cancel reject is for an unknown order this field will contain the text Unknown. Otherwise, it will contain the OrderID of the last order in the chain of orders.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique order id assigned by broker to the cancel request or to the replacement order.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID that could not be canceled/replaced. ClOrdID of the previous order (NOT the initial order of the day) when canceling or replacing an order.

Field.Name: OrdStatus
Field.Description: OrdStatus value after this cancel reject is applied.

Field.Name: CxlRejReason
Field.Description: Code to identify reason for cancel rejection: 0 = Too late to cancel, 1 = Unknown order, 2 = Broker Option (used for unidentified business reasons), 3 = Order already in Pending Cancel status

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: See Rejected Order Reasons and Cancel Reject Reason (section 7).

Field.Name: CxlRejResponseTo
Field.Description: Identifies the type of request that a Cancel Reject is in response to: 1 = Order Cancel Request, 2 = Order Cancel/Replace Request

Message.Name: OrderMassCancelReport
Message.Description: RapidFire and Kill-Switch Notification, Purge/Reset Response: notifies firms when Rapid Fire Risk Protection is triggered in an underlying or when Kill-Switch is applied/reset for a firm, and responds to purge or Underlying Reset requests.

Field.Name: ClientID
Field.Description: NASDAQ MPID/ Firm mnemonic. This tag will be absent for Kill-Switch notifications.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Exchange assigned unique Identifier of the notification for the trading session. Blank if tag 531 is 0 (request is rejected). For Kill-Switch notifications, the value has the form <PORT Identifier>-<Firm Mnemonic>-<Kill-Switch Trigger Id>

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Named CLOrdID in the document. Present if this is a response to a purge or reset request from the firm.

Field.Name: RequestType
Field.Description: Present if this is a response to Firm's Purge or Reset Request or if this is a Kill-Switch notification: 8 = Reset, 2 = Purge

Field.Name: Response
Field.Description: 0 = Purge/Reset Request Rejected (tag 532 contains more information), 7 = Purge by another port (FIX/OTTO/SQF or system support), 8 = Purge/Reset Request Successful, 9 = RapidFire Notification, K = Kill-Switch Notification

Field.Name: RejectReason
Field.Description: Present if tag 531 is 0: 0 = Feature Not Supported, 2 = Invalid Underlying

Field.Name: UnderlyingSymbol
Field.Description: UnderlyingSymbol that is purged/reset or rapid fired. Omitted if all underlyings for the firm are purged as a result of a firm level purge request from a SQF port; a reset request is required for each underlying after the firm receives a firm level purge notification.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Provides additional information about this message.

Message.Name: RequestForPrismNotification
Message.Description: Request for PRISM Notification: provides the details of a Request for PRISM to recipients who have opted in (port by port) before responding. For consumption only; responses are sent with New Order Single. Initiating firm identification is not provided.

Field.Name: RFPID
Field.Description: Unique identifier assigned by the exchange

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: f = InterMarket Sweep Order (ISO). RFP responder must provide ISO when notification includes it, else be rejected

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: 1 = Market, 2 = Limit

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Required if OrdType = 2

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: 1 = Buy, 2 = Sell

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: OSI symbol for a series.

Field.Name: SecurityType
Field.Description: OPT

Field.Name: PutOrCall
Field.Description: 0 = Put, 1 = Call

Field.Name: Rule80A
Field.Description: Named Rule80A/OrderCapacity in the document. C = Customer order, B = Broker Dealer Order, F = Firm order, M = Nasdaq registered market maker order, O = Other Exchange registered market maker order, P = Professional Customer, J = Joint Back Office

Field.Name: MaturityDate
Field.Description: Month, Day and Year of the maturity. Format YYYYMMDD (e.g. 20100918 to represent Sept 18, 2010)

Field.Name: ListSeqNo
Field.Description: Order Number within the list, unique within a given order list message. If one side is customer origin and the other is not, the customer side is the agency side; otherwise the agency order must be the first order in the list and the initiating order the second. Denotes the start of an order definition and must be the first tag at the start of each order in the list.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the order as assigned by institution. Must be 20 characters or less.

Field.Name: HandlInst
Field.Description: If provided, must be set to 1 = Automated execution order, private, no Broker intervention

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: 1 - 6 character Options Root Symbol. Spaces, periods, commas not allowed.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of order: 1 = Buy, 2 = Sell

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Required. Acceptable range is 1 to 999999. Both sides must specify same order quantity.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: 1 = Market, 2 = Limit. Each side must be LIMIT and the contra side price must match the agency side price.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price field is required for Limit Orders. 1-10 character decimal price.

Field.Name: ClientID
Field.Description: Used for firm identification. Service bureaus must use this field to specify the firm entering the order. The firm identifier must be a valid mnemonic assigned by the exchange and the firm must be an approved member of the exchange. If this field is not provided by the firm, the default mnemonic associated with the FIX port will be used.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Must be 32 characters or less.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: Conditional. G = AON: optional on Agency side of PRISM Cross orders, invalid on Initiating Order. f = ISO: optional on either side of PRISM Cross Orders.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: 0 = DAY, 1 = GTC, 3 = IOC (Immediate or Cancel). All of the preceding values are converted to IOC before processing; all other values will be rejected.

Field.Name: Rule80A
Field.Description: Named Rule80A/OrderCapacity in the document. C = customer order, B = BrokerDealer Order, F = firm order, M = Nasdaq registered market maker order, O = Other Exchange registered market maker order, P = Professional Customer, J = Joint Back Office. If not specified, will default to C (Customer order).

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Firms can use this field in order message to supply optional clearing data field that is sent to OCC. If field is supplied, NASDAQ will allow only 13 characters and use it for supplementary ID in the order.

Field.Name: OpenClose
Field.Description: O = opening position, C = closing position

Field.Name: SecurityType
Field.Description: If provided, must be OPT = options

Field.Name: MaturityMonthYear
Field.Description: Format: YYYYMM (expiration date). If this tag and Maturity Date (tag 541) is specified the year and month must match, otherwise the order will be rejected. Required unless Maturity Date is specified.

Field.Name: MaturityDay
Field.Description: Format: DD (Expiration date-day of the month). If supplied, this data will be validated. If this tag and Maturity Date (tag 541) is specified the day must match, otherwise the order will be rejected. Required unless Maturity Date is specified.

Field.Name: MaturityDate
Field.Description: Month, Day and Year of the maturity. Format YYYYMMDD (e.g. 20100918 to represent Sept 18, 2010). If this tag and MaturityMonthYear and MaturityDay is specified the year, month and day must match, otherwise the order will be rejected. Required unless MaturityMonthYear AND MaturityDay is specified.

Field.Name: PutOrCall
Field.Description: 0 = put, 1 = call

Field.Name: StrikePrice
Field.Description: Strike Price for option. Valid values: 0 - 999999.99999999

Field.Name: ClearingAccount
Field.Description: Up to 5-character alphanumeric. If tag is not supplied, spaces will be used. This field is passed through to the OCC sub-account/multi-account field; at the OCC this field is used to clear the trade to the proper sub account. The value is sometimes referred to as Badge # or Market Maker ID and is usually a 1-4-character alphanumeric acronym. Nasdaq will forward only left most 4 characters to OCC. Required if Order Capacity (tag 47) is M or O.

Field.Name: SecurityExchange
Field.Description: Exchange ID of Market Maker. When Rule80A/Capacity is O, this field should indicate Exchange where Market Maker is registered. If not provided, will default to Q for NOM and T for BX Options.

Field.Name: ClearingFirm
Field.Description: CMTA Number (firm that will clear the trade) up to 5-character numeric. If tag not supplied, this order will not be a CMTA.

Field.Name: AllocAccount
Field.Description: Exchange Internal Firm Identifier of the Directed Participant for Directed Order Flow; should not exceed 4 characters. Only processed for the agency order; ignored for the initiating order.
